relevance_note: Case report of one female with genetically confirmed Danon disease: 'Genetic testing confirmed the diagnosis of Danon disease with lysosome-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP2) mutation (Va1310Ile mutation).'
method_note: Read the paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON from hand-written values and generated the 20 checklist rows per person, then checked spans verbatim. In scope: the case patient ('patient'), the previously published 20-year-old male of Marino et al. [16] ('ref [16] patient'; sex, age and features given), and the 3 Spinazzi et al. [15] cases ('ref [15] patient', '... 2', '... 3'), included because the paper gives features for 'all 3' (stroke, severe LV dysfunction, prominent concentric hypertrophy); their features are recorded as inferred from that named-group statement. Izumi et al. [14] is HCM, not Danon disease: out of scope. The parents ('neither biological parent has Danon disease') were not given rows: they are neither described as tested nor as affected, and no other individual-level fact is given; the statement is not parental testing, so inheritance and parental_testing_statement are 'not reported'. The variant is printed as 'Va1310Ile' (the digit 1 where 'l' would be expected); recorded exactly as printed in variant_original_string and protein_hgvs_as_stated, without correction; no p. prefix, cDNA, transcript, zygosity or variant class is printed. Age at onset left 'not reported': the earliest finding is hypertrophy noted 'At 8 years of age' at referral for chest pain and palpitation, which is not stated as symptom onset; feature onsets are recorded per feature. Age at diagnosis left 'not reported': genetic testing is mentioned after the age-12 catheterization but no age is stated for it. Vital status left 'not reported' (not stated explicitly). Checklist 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle' excluded from 'normal systolic function', %EF 76% and LVIDd Z-score −2.7 (Table 1). 'Heart failure' excluded from 'never developed congestive heart failure'. 'Supraventricular tachycardia (atrial fibrillation or flutter)' left not reported: only atrial fibrillation is excluded (narrow absence). LVOT obstruction excluded from 'nonobstructive' at age 8. Normal findings recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27): normal cardiac index, normal pulmonary vascular resistance, normal coagulation profile, normal systolic function. TIA is hedged in the case narrative ('high possibility of transient ischemic attack') but stated plainly in the abstract and conclusion; recorded observed with both spans. No contradictions found. No stacked cells.

span: A right anterior accessory pathway was identified and was ablated with cryotherapy.
She was started on atenolol, but she was not compliant with the medication. At 13 years and 4 months of age, she underwent implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) implantation
Her medication was switched to nadolol.
she was placed on daily aspirin, which she did not take regularly

She was started on continuous intravenous heparin infusion for initial anticoagulation. Her motor function recovered after intensive rehabilitation. There has been no recurrence of feeling of numbness, hemiplegia, or aphasia after she was placed on daily warfarin under strict supervision.
